facts.fact: La Nation reports that the National Assembly adopted law no. 2025-12 amending article 6 of law no. 2017-08 of 19 June 2017 on the identification of natural persons (the law behind the national register and the NPI); the 2017 law is treated as the law in force, an ordinary law, and the amending law's promulgation is not stated.

facts.fact: Article 6 as amended by law no. 2025-12 under law no. 2017-08 provides for a national biometric population register and a personal identification number (NPI) for each person entered, including special numbers for foreigners and for Afro-descendant naturalised persons.
